name: Cloudscape Design System
bestFor: cloud consoles, admin and operations tools with tables, filters, wizards and resource detail pages
products that must offer user-switchable comfortable/compact density and light/dark modes
data visualisation dashboards (chart palettes indexed by contrast ratio, light/dark pairs)
teams wanting an opinionated app shell (AppLayout, SideNavigation, SplitPanel, HelpPanel, Flashbar)
avoidFor: marketing sites and brand-led consumer products (looks like the AWS console)
highly custom visual identities (raw palette not exposed; theming is limited to the documented theming API)
content/editorial reading experiences (14px body is tuned for scanning, not long-form)

families: base/heading/display: 'Open Sans', 'Helvetica Neue', Roboto, Arial, sans-serif
monospace: Monaco, Menlo, Consolas, 'Courier Prime', Courier, 'Courier New', monospace
typography.notes: Tracking tightens progressively with size (0 at 14px, -0.005em at 16, -0.01 at 18, -0.015 at 20, -0.02 at 24, -0.03 at display). Headings all 700; display-xl drops to 400 for a lighter large voice. Buttons and tabs are 700 weight.

accents.border-button-normal: #006ce0 (normal buttons are outlined in accent blue)

semantic.charts: color-charts-<hue>-<300..1200> where the step number is the contrast ratio against the background (300 = 3:1, 400 = 4:1 ... ), each with light and dark values

color.darkMode: Every colour token carries {light, dark} values (visual modes); switched by class at runtime. Dark main surface #161d26, dropdown #1b232d. Accent lightens to #42b4ff in dark and primary button text flips to #0f141a. Additionally 'contexts' (top-navigation, header, alert-header) apply a dark token set locally inside light pages (~188 overrides).
color.contrastNotes: Docs require sufficient contrast and never colour-alone (pair with icon/text); no numeric ratio on the colours page. Measured: accent #006ce0 vs white 4.97:1; dark accent #42b4ff vs #161d26 7.44:1; input border #8c8c94 vs white 3.34:1 (meets 3:1 non-text); divider #c6c6cd vs white 1.65:1 (decorative only). Chart tokens are named by contrast ratio, which is the most rigorous colour naming in the set.

spacing.notes: Names xxxs..xxxl. Two families: space-static-* (never change) and space-scaled-* (shrink in compact: xxxs 2->0, xxs 4->2, xs 8->4, s 12->8, m 16->12, l 20->16, xl 24->20, xxl 32->24, xxxl 40->32). Docs: container horizontal padding 20px, card vertical 16px, label-to-control 4px, between fields 20px, checkbox-to-label 8px, grid gutter 20px fixed, page header to content 16px; soft grid (relative to line-height) not baseline grid.

radius.rule: Role-named radii: badge 4, input/dropdown/popover/item/token/tiles 8, alert/flashbar/dropzone 12, container/card 16, button 20 (pill at 32px height). Inline token 4, focus rings 4.

shadows: other shadow tokens (dropdown, modal, popover, sticky): not exposed in the public design-tokens package -> unknown
depth.borders: Borders do most of the separation work: 2px for buttons, alerts, dropdowns, popovers, tokens, selected items; 1px for fields, cards, side navigation. Icon stroke widths are tokenised by icon size (x-small 1.5px ... large 4px).

motion.notes: Every motion token has a 'disabled' mode value of 0ms, so reduced motion and test runs (disableMotion()) are token-level switches. Recipes: dropdown/modal fade+scale A 115ms; side panels slide A 115ms; flashbar slide from top C 250ms; error shake 5px each side A 165ms; link hover C 165ms; popover hide-on-hover-out uses Curve B so it lingers. Long ambient tokens exist for gen-AI avatar gradient (3600ms) and loading dots (1200ms).

components.stateMatrixCompleteness: Very high: 413 colour tokens, each light+dark, covering default/hover/active/disabled/selected/focused/read-only per control family; status icons have their own keyframes. Count = top-level component directories in @cloudscape-design/components 3.0.1394 (includes a few sub-parts such as table-row).

tokenArchitecture: Single flat public layer of ~570 kebab-case semantic tokens (color-background-button-primary-default, space-scaled-m, border-radius-container, motion-duration-responsive) with DTCG-style $value objects keyed by MODE: colour by visual mode {light, dark}, spacing/sizing by density {comfortable, compact}, motion by {default, disabled}. Raw palette is private. Contexts (compact-table, top-navigation, header, flashbar, alert, app-layout-toolbar) are scoped override sets applied inside a region. Public theming API overrides tokens per mode/context.
distinctiveness: Mode-keyed token values (light/dark, comfortable/compact, default/disabled motion) in one file; static vs scaled spacing; contextual token sets that make a dark header inside a light page; chart colours named by guaranteed contrast ratio; pill buttons with 2px accent outline for secondary actions.
weaknesses: Raw colour palette and most shadow values are not in the public token package
Strong AWS console look; hard to make feel like a different brand
14px body and 32px controls are dense for consumer/mobile
Compact mode deliberately not applied to alerts, help panels, dropdown items and charts, so density is partial by design
takeaways: Key every token by its mode axis inside the token itself ({light,dark}, {comfortable,compact}, {default,disabled}) rather than separate theme files
Split spacing into 'scaled' (shrinks in compact) and 'static' (never changes) so density changes never break structural gutters
Name chart/data colours by the contrast ratio they guarantee against the surface (red-400 = 4:1)
Use token 'contexts' to restyle a region (dark top nav, coloured alert header) without new components
Make reduced motion a token mode (all durations to 0ms) so components need no per-component media queries
Tighten letter-spacing progressively with size (0 at 14px to -0.03em at display)
